title: Birds That Don’t Exist

about.name: Birds That Don't Exist: Niche Pre-Emption as a Constraint on Morphological Evolution in the Passeroidea
about.quote: We identify a persistent morphological gap densely surrounded by extant species but unoccupied throughout passeroid diversification.
about.label: Ecology Letters

about.name: bird-morphology-tda
about.quote: The project applies persistent homology (topological data analysis) to morphological trait data reconstructed through time to identify and characterize unoccupied regions ("gaps") in Passeroidea morphospace.
about.label: GitHub (Stephanie Chia)

about.name: AVONET: morphological, ecological and geographical data for all birds
about.quote: The AVONET database contains comprehensive functional trait data for all birds, including six ecological variables, eleven continuous morphological traits, and information on range size and location.
about.label: figshare

here: Here: the 420 of Chia et al.’s 1,378 passeroid species nearest the centre of their focal gap, as the first four principal components of ten AVONET body measurements (A) and as AVONET diet, lifestyle, habitat, migration, range size and latitude (B).
